name: Great Smoky Mountains National Park
about: Spring wildflowers, a two-week synchronous firefly show in late May/early June, and Oct fall foliage are its three signature seasons.
overview: The most-visited national park in the US, with no entrance fee — the ridge-top Appalachian scenery draws over 12 million visitors a year.
costOverview: The rare national park with no entrance fee at all, just a small daily parking pass — though Gatlinburg's tourist-district coffee and pancake houses charge real markup once you're off the trail.

specialSeasons.text: This is synchronous firefly season — a roughly two-week window (dates announced each year) when thousands of fireflies flash in unison. Viewing at the main site is by lottery.
Peak fall foliage across the park, though color moves down the mountain through the month as elevation drops.
Peak spring wildflower bloom, among the most diverse displays of any national park.
